map_rule: Among the five published original Master3s2 development maps for the exact same deterministic parent, exclude the prior outcome-selected late map 621456920. Choose the first three remaining numeric map seeds. Each retains both seat trajectories. The only one of these three maps untouched by any earlier responsive-branch study is reserved for the present holdout. This is a map-disjoint holdout for these new labels only, all three are previously exposed development maps.
own_return: Own collector carrying at least 20, 0<distance to own nearest base<=remaining joint steps, actual order does not shorten that distance, alternative does shorten it, no one-turn hostile collector with less/equal load can reach alternative destination.
deny_enemy_return: Enemy collector carries at least 40, own collector strictly lighter, target at enemy-home distance 2..min(5,remaining), alternative destination is one of enemy collector's immediate shortest return squares. Exclude routes blocked by other hostile light collectors.
eligibility: Use current player's public roster, cargo, positions and own recorded joint action. Alternative differs on one worker; no friendly joint-destination collision or same-turn recruiting-center conflict, cannot enter rival base. Do not inspect opponent's actual root command or future, margins, labels, or prior fixed-order counterfactuals for selection.
selection: Pool both physical seats in each map. For each family choose the largest qualifying cargo (own for return; enemy for denial), ties by SHA256(late-cash-01|seed|seat|t|worker|alternative|enemy_worker). Max one root per map per family; for denial skip identical seat/time/worker of selected return. Missing families remain missing and no replacement maps are allowed.
continuation: Two independently drawn streams per root. Within stream both arms share fresh actual Master3s2 temperature-1 RNG state, measured warm search budget, historical visible observations and original simultaneous enemy root move. Next step onwards both full parent and full examiner respond to respective branch observations; official termination and payoffs. Data and the designated heldout map are written separately; no fitting under this three-map pilot.
